mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates and enhances equity valuation multiples, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in labor market growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.5% MoM) and housing starts (HOUST < 1500 thousand units) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both PAYEMS growth < 0.5% and HOUST < 1500, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market boom (HOUST > 1600 thousand units), increased consumer confidence and construction activity drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when HOUST > 1600, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY) signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) indicates a contraction in the manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.3% MoM) signals weakening labor market conditions, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS growth < 0.3%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1 < 0.0%) indicates a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 < 0.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
